title: How to Build a Task Management App with AI (No Code Required)
summary: How to build a task management app with AI in 2026. Step-by-step guide with exact prompts, database setup, auth, and live deployment — no config needed.
body_markdown:
Blink includes the database automatically — no Supabase account needed. Your tasks are stored immediately in a real database with proper schema. You’ll see a tasks table with title, description, due_date, priority, status, and project_id columns created from your description.


The generated app is editable. Click any element to modify it or type follow-up instructions to add or change features.
